title: alocasia navicularis
intro: Alocasia navicularis, commonly known as the shield elephant ear, is a species of flowering plant in the family Arum. This plant is known for its large, shield-shaped leaves that provide a unique appearance in indoor gardens. The health benefits of Alocasia navicularis include its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels due to its antioxidant properties. Its leaves are rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been found to have therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
